import numpy as np
y=dA_dt
edges=np.linspace(0.5,10.0001,21)
B=np.zeros((len(t),len(edges)-1))
for i in range(len(edges)-1):
    B[:,i]=((t>=edges[i])&(t<edges[i+1])).astype(float)
def test(f,name):
    X=np.column_stack([B,f])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)
    print(name,round(c[-1],4),'nmse',np.mean((y-X@c)**2)/np.var(y))
for n in [0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5,2]:

test(np.log(1+A),'ln(1+A)')
test(1-np.exp(-A),'1-exp(-A)')
test(A*np.exp(-0.1*A),'A exp(-.1A)')
